tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.name: Connected-app web-address ID checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.description: Checks apps that identify themselves by the web address of their description document.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.name: Connected apps list checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.description: Checks that people see and disconnect their own apps and an Owner can see every app.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.name: Connected apps on/off switch checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.description: Checks the farm setting that allows or blocks connected apps.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.name: Connected-app token safety checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.description: Checks that a connected app's access token is refused in the same situations a normal sign-in would be.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.name: Connected-app disconnect on password change checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.description: Checks that apps are disconnected when the person's credentials change.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.name: Connected-app cleanup checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.description: Checks that expired app tokens and approvals are cleared out by the routine cleanup.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.name: Connected-app production setup checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.description: Checks that the app sign-in server runs in production mode and handles a client end to end.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.name: Connected-app sign-in flow checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/OAu.description: Checks the full approve-and-receive-token flow for apps, and that its tokens cannot be used elsewhere.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/One.name: Command-line minimal setup checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/One.description: Checks that each command-line job runs with only the bare minimum settings in production.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ope.name: Operator command exactness checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ope.description: Checks two details of what operator commands pass along that no other test pinned down.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Otl.name: Monitoring export setting checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Otl.description: Checks how the settings for sending monitoring data are read and validated.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Otl.name: Monitoring export security checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Otl.description: Checks that production refuses insecure settings for sending monitoring data.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Otl.name: Monitoring export launch checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Otl.description: Checks monitoring data export by launching the app as a separate process.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Own.name: Owner setup chain checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Own.description: Checks the steps that create the first Owner of a farm from a fresh database.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Own.name: Owner two-step sign-in requirement checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Own.description: Checks that Owners must use two-step sign-in once the grace period ends.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Own.name: Owner two-step rule unit checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Own.description: Checks the small decision rule that blocks Owners without two-step sign-in.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pay.name: Customer payment checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pay.description: Checks customer payments: tied to an order, same currency, and no paying more than owed.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pla.name: Unencrypted key detection checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pla.description: Checks the guard that spots stored security keys left unencrypted.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pos.name: Database address checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pos.description: Checks that database connection settings are cleaned up and validated correctly.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pos.name: Single-leader lock checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pos.description: Checks that only one app server at a time holds the lead for background jobs.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pro.name: Server-only startup check tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pro.description: Checks that startup safety checks for the web server do not block one-off command-line jobs.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pro.name: Command-line job list checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pro.description: Checks the list that says which commands are one-off jobs.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pro.name: Product audit detail checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pro.description: Checks that creating or editing a product records its type and unit in the audit trail.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pro.name: Production log format checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pro.description: Checks that production writes logs in a structured form a log collector can read.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pro.name: Create-account command checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pro.description: Checks the command-line tool that sets up a new farm account.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pro.name: New farm setup checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Pro.description: Checks that a new farm gets its default egg grades and starting data.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Qua.name: Cracked and dirty egg checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Qua.description: Checks that cracked and dirty eggs become sellable stock through their own counts.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Que.name: Database query warning checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Que.description: Checks that risky database query patterns are flagged.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Rat.name: Rate-limit setting checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Rat.description: Checks that bad rate-limit settings stop the app at startup rather than failing later.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Rat.name: Sign-in rate-limit checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Rat.description: Checks that too many sign-in attempts from one address are refused.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Rat.name: Rate-limit grouping checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Rat.description: Checks how requests are grouped by address for rate limiting.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Rea.name: Read screen checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Rea.description: Checks reading a daily entry, stock by grade and sales orders.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Rec.name: Recover-admin command checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Rec.description: Checks the emergency command-line tool that restores access for a locked-out admin.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Red.name: Secret-holding type checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Red.description: Checks that every code type holding a credential refuses to print its value.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Red.name: Secret printing guard checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Red.description: Checks the scanner that makes sure secret-holding types print only a fixed placeholder.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Red.name: Log redaction pipeline checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Red.description: Checks that the real logging setup blanks out sensitive values.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ref.name: Session renewal farm-match checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ref.description: Checks that renewing a session fails if the browser tab expects a different farm.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ref.name: Session renewal timing race checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ref.description: Checks renewal of a session at the edge of its grace period when two requests collide.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ref.name: Session renewal flow checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ref.description: Checks that session renewal keys are stored durably and swapped for a new one each use.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ref.name: Old session cleanup batch checks
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ref.description: Checks that old session keys are cleared in small batches so a big backlog does not stall.
